about.title: About me
about.paragraph1: I'm Alexander, an AI automation specialist and web developer. I like solving problems by building systems that remove repetitive manual work, such as a chatbot that takes orders or a workflow that moves leads into a CRM. I also work as an AI Researcher at Hurdman, Inc.
about.paragraph2: I connect platforms with ManyChat, GoHighLevel, Zapier and Pabbly, and I build sites with WordPress, Elementor and Shopify. I also write the SOPs and documentation that help teams use new tools. Still learning. Always building.

projects.jlptLabSubtitle: Daily AI testing and research to find which tools, workflows and use cases really work for the team, with SOPs and guides to match.

overview.title: Project Overview
overview.p1: This project covers my ongoing work as an AI Researcher at Hurdman, Inc.
overview.p2: The goal is to find out what current AI tools can really do in practice, beyond the marketing claims. That means using them daily, comparing models, and seeing how each one handles real workflows.
overview.p3: Instead of treating AI as a single tool, I see it as a fast-moving ecosystem where new capabilities and trade-offs appear every week. Tracking that change is part of the job.
overview.p4: The findings shape how the team thinks about automation, content and product direction.

coreIdea.title: Core Concept
coreIdea.p1: At the heart of this work is a simple question: where does AI really make a difference?
coreIdea.p2: Rather than chasing every trend, I focus on hands-on testing. I try tools on concrete tasks, compare the results, and document what works and what doesn't. The aim is practical insight the team can use, not a hype recap.

userFriendly.title: How It's Shared
userFriendly.p1: The research is built to be easy to use.
userFriendly.p2: I create short videos, written summaries, side-by-side comparisons and step-by-step SOPs, so the team can understand the findings and repeat the workflows without running every experiment themselves.

status.title: Current Status
status.p1: The research is ongoing and updated continuously.
status.p2: New tools, models and use cases are added as they appear, and priorities change based on what the team and product need most at the time.

purpose.title: Project Purpose
purpose.p1: The purpose of this work is to keep Hurdman ahead on AI: which tools to adopt, which to skip, and how to use them to get real, repeatable results.
